gitCommit.subject: fix(ci): handle 200 from redeem API + disable one-time spin tokens in CI
gitCommit.body:
fix(ci): handle 200 from redeem API + disable one-time spin tokens in CI

- sakura-fidelity.spec.ts: when /api/redeem returns 200, assert atomicity
  invariant (balance unchanged) instead of failing on unexpected status
- rewards.api.spec.ts: TOKEN_AVAILABLE=false — spin tokens are single-use
  (Google review tokens), CI token is exhausted after first run
